nope.class: That’s C++. In C, class is a perfectly good variable name.
nope.new: That’s C++. In C, new is a perfectly good variable name.
nope.main: Not a keyword, just a function with a special job.
nope.include: A preprocessor directive, not a keyword.
nope.define: A preprocessor directive, not a keyword.
nope.null: NULL is a macro. C23 did add the nullptr keyword.
nope.string: C has no string type. Just arrays of char, and hope.
nope.asm: A common extension, but not standard C.
